extracted.name: Chef John's Summer Scrambled Eggs
extracted.description: Chef John's recipe for scrambled eggs with cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, and fresh basil is a delicious breakfast option for any time of the year.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon very thinly sliced fresh basil leaves
instruction_lines: Whisk eggs and pepper flakes together in a bowl. Stir in tomatoes, feta, and basil.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over high heat until starting to shimmer. Pour egg mixture into hot oil and cook, without stirring, for 5 seconds.
Cook and stir egg mixture until eggs are scrambled and softly set, about 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with sea salt.
